verdict.against: A -2% stop on a name with an ATR near 8% gets hit by normal noise, and the after-hours high already faded about 5 points into the open.

headlines: Nov 12, 11:38 AM ET · 24/7 Wall St. · Microsoft Is Fighting a Ban on Chinese Parts Inside AI Data Centers

verdict.catalyst: No company-specific news found for FN on Nov 12-13. The headline it was screened on is a Reuters-sourced piece (iTnews, Nov 11, 2026) saying Microsoft is lobbying the administration to drop a planned ban on Chinese optical transceivers. The article does not name Fabrinet. The move looks like a sector-wide AI-optics selloff, not a stock-specific event. FN closed Nov 12 at $353.61, down 4.17%, per Seeking Alpha.
verdict.why: The stop at -2% sits inside this name's normal noise. FN has moved 4% or more in single sessions repeatedly this month, including a 14% drop on Nov 5, and it is already down about 9% on the day after a 33% one-month slide, with RSI at 15. The screen's ATR figures also don't reconcile with a -9.13% move at -0.33 ATR, so I can't confirm the lead is as large as it looks. The Microsoft story also cuts against a short, since a restriction on Chinese transceivers would arguably help domestic manufacturers like Fabrinet. I see no specific reason the move continues beyond a flush that can bounce hard.
verdict.against: The sell-off is already extreme, with RSI at 15, a 9% day and a 33% one-month drop, so a 2% stop is likely to be hit by an ordinary bounce before any continuation.
verdict.coming: NVIDIA fiscal Q3 2027 results and call are set for Nov 17, 2026 at 5 PM ET (confirmed in NVIDIA's Oct 28 press release). That falls after this trade's flat-by time, but it is inside the next few days. Fabrinet's next report is in early February, per TIKR.

verdict.catalyst: Southern Company announced a $1.75B 2026 Series A equity units offering on Nov 12, 2026 (Simply Wall St headline, Nov 12, 6:26 PM ET), and IndexBox (Nov 13, 2026) reports it priced 35M units at 8.625% with a $92.47 reference price. I found no company news that explains a move on Nov 13 itself, and the offering is a dilutive financing, not a fundamental catalyst.
verdict.why: The name is up 0.8% against XLU's -0.05%, a lead of under 1%, and the 4.8x relative volume comes from a financing whose hedging and convert-repurchase flows can drive it rather than from new demand. The stock is trading just above the $92.47 reference price, so pricing held, but the equity overhang and unwind of the 2024A converts could reverse a move that has no news behind it. The stop at -0.98% is about half the name's daily ATR (roughly 1.9%, implied by the 0.43 ATR reading), which is inside normal intraday noise.
verdict.against: The move is financing-related flow with no fundamental catalyst, and the dilutive units settling Nov 17 give the stock a supply overhang that could pull it back through the stop.
verdict.coming: Units close Nov 17, 2026 (IndexBox), and the over-allotment option (5M units) is open for 13 days after issuance. One source lists Q4 2026 earnings on Nov 18, 2026, but this is unverified and conflicts with the usual February report timing. Nothing else found.
